message: No detected input validation: The code accepts command-line arguments and processes data tensors without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: The code loads data from local datasets (rot_mnist, pacs, etc.) via torchvision/custom loaders with no checksum verification, signed URL, or pinned revision handling visible in the slice.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, validation against expected label sets, or label-noise detection tools are used anywhere in the visible code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is performed in any of the visible data preparation functions.

No detected model integrity verification: The code accepts a --pre_trained flag and loads model architectures (e.g., resnet18) but no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision is performed on any loaded weights.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no backdoor defenses such as trigger detection, activation clustering, or gradient anomaly analysis.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanism is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics being used to guard against metric manipulation in the visible code.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed on incoming data before it is passed to the model; the code only parses CLI arguments and processes tensors directly.

No detected output bounds checks: There are NaN checks inside embedding_dist for intermediate tensors, but no post-inference output bounds or probability sanity checks are applied to the model's final predictions.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a vision/tabular ML pipeline (MNIST, PACS, etc.), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
